Générateur Vidéo IA 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Generate AI-powered videos from text or image prompts, no filming needed.
- Supports uploads up to 200MB; accepts MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG.
- Fast, cloud-based rendering with 1080p MP4 output—typically in 1-2 minutes.
- Handles prompts for exporting, credits, status, uploads, and general video editing.
- Anonymous users get free trial credits for quick video creation.
- Designed for marketers, creators, and entrepreneurs seeking simple video generation.
